title: Membership 2026: Last Call
excerpt: A reminder that 2026 membership closes at the end of July. All players must be registered to train and play.
body:
A reminder that 2026 membership closes at the end of July. All players must be registered to train and play — this is an insurance requirement and there are no exceptions.

Membership can be paid online through the club's registration system or in person to any committee member.

If cost is a barrier for any family, please contact the club secretary in confidence — no child will ever be turned away.
